v1.rules: Buys the side BTC is on (Yes above the strike, No below) when BTC is at least $25 from the strike, the ask is 35–65¢, and 2+ minutes remain. Scores the 1m EMA 9/21/50, MACD, RSI and the 5-minute trend to pick its conviction. The 15-minute trend must not point against the side. Spot-derived fair value must be at least the ask (no overpaying). Price must be on the trade’s side of 1m VWAP. At most 1 ticket per 15-minute window and never the opposite side of a held ticket. Holds every ticket to official Kalshi settlement (no early exits).

v2.label: Version 2.2 · Strict + Fair-Value Edge

v2.rules: Buys Yes/No when the 1-minute trend is clean, BTC is at least $40 from the strike, the ask is 35–75¢, and 2–15 minutes remain in the window. Requires the 50-period EMA to agree. Sells early at the live Kalshi bid only when BTC breaks back through the strike and the 1m EMA 9/21 plus MACD both flip against the ticket. Otherwise holds to official settlement.
